Name: Tokiri's Animals for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I saw these animals on strifedanish's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13332]Adopt'n'Skin Tokiri's Pets[/url] and Tokiri gave permission for their assets to be freely used [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/tokiris-pet-replacements-fox-wolf-red-panda-update-red-panda-finished.110263/]here[/url], so I've updated and converted them to be new barn animals in 1.6! 

This mod adds 4 new barn animals that can be purchased from Marnie:

-Red Foxes: will dig up mixed seeds and ﻿geodes
-Red Pandas: will dig up mixed seeds and ﻿tee leaves
-Wolves: will dig up Artifact Troves when friendship is high
-Hippogriffs: will dig up clay and Fiddlehead Ferns

Enjoy!
